fusions.name: Rod of Rank
fusions.desc: Brings a raised rod down on an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 30 damage, growing the further it reaches, up to 1.3 times at full reach. On a hit, your allies' damage rises by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Cowing Glare
fusions.desc: Rears up and glares down every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stunning each for 0.8 seconds and stripping 10% of their armour and 15% of their movement speed for 5 seconds. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unchallenged
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Deference Owed
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
